hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; d="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$d")"; s="$d/AGENTS/epistemic-rules/tools/session_brief.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || { echo "Session brief hook: script not found ($s). Follow AGENTS/epistemic-rules/session-boundaries.md (session start) manually."; exit 0; }; h="${EPISTEMIC_HOME:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}}"; p="$h/.epistemic/python"; c0=""; [ -f "$p" ] && c0="$(head -n 1 "$p" | tr -d '\r')"; for c in "$c0" python3 python 'py -3'; do [ -n "$c" ] || continue; if $c -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $c -B "$s" "$d" --hook-json; fi; done; echo 'Session brief hook: Python 3.9+ not found. Write the Python command to ~/.epistemic/python or follow AGENTS/epistemic-rules/workspace-setup.md (first install).'
